info.name: StartupKaro API
info.description:
# StartupKaro API

Backend for the StartupKaro services marketplace. Customers browse a catalog of business / legal / tax / licensing services, pay via **Razorpay**, and track their orders; advisors handle quote-based work.

## The three purchase tracks
Every service has a `pricingType` and an `isPurchasable` flag. The public catalog derives a **`cta`** field (`buy` / `subscribe` / `quote`) so the frontend knows which path to render:

**1. buy** — one-time checkout for `fixed` / `per_unit` / `starting_from` services that are purchasable (incl. bundles).
`Customer > Purchases > Initiate Purchase` → open Razorpay Checkout with the returned `razorpayOrderId` + `razorpayKeyId` → `Verify Payment`. The `payment.captured` webhook also confirms the order server-side (source of truth).

**2. subscribe** — `recurring` services (e.g. GST / TDS compliance) billed **monthly** via Razorpay Subscriptions.
`Customer > Subscriptions > Subscribe` (lazily creates the Razorpay Plan) → checkout with the returned `razorpaySubscriptionId` → `Verify Subscription`. `subscription.*` webhooks keep status + `currentPeriodEnd` in sync. `Cancel Subscription` cancels at cycle end.

**3. quote** — advisor-priced work (query-based, or scope-variable "starting from").
Customer submits `Customer > Inquiry (Public) > Submit Inquiry` (optionally with `serviceId`) → advisor agrees a price → `Admin > Inquiries > Generate Payment Link` creates a **Razorpay Payment Link** sent by email/SMS → `payment_link.paid` webhook marks it paid. These services are `isPurchasable=false`, so direct checkout is blocked.

## Pricing & GST
All money is in **paise** (₹ × 100). GST is 18% (`taxRatePct = 1800`) and computed at checkout. `priceInclusiveOfTax = true` means the listed price already includes GST (the marketed bundles); otherwise GST is added on top. The catalog returns a `pricing` breakdown `{ base, tax, total }` plus a human `priceLabel` (e.g. "Starting at ₹1,500", "₹2,500 / application", "On request").

## Bundles & add-ons
Bundle services (`isBundle = true`) group several services at a flat price and expose their line-items (`GET service/:slug`). Services can carry cross-sell **add-ons** selectable at checkout via `addonIds`. `per_unit` services accept a `quantity`.

## Setup
1. **Admin > Auth > Login (Root Admin)** — admin tokens auto-populate.
2. **Customer > Auth > Signup** or **Login** — customer tokens auto-populate.
3. IDs auto-save from list/create responses into collection variables.

## Auto-populated variables
- `admin_access_token` / `admin_refresh_token`, `customer_access_token` / `customer_refresh_token`
- `service_id`, `category_id`, `addon_id`, `bundle_item_id`
- `order_id` / `order_number`, `razorpay_order_id`, `payment_id`
- `subscription_id` / `razorpay_subscription_id`
- `inquiry_id`, `payment_link_id`, `customer_id`, `reset_token`

item.name: Categories

request.description: Creates a category. `slug` must be unique, kebab-case. Optional `parentId` for a sub-category.
Deletes a category. Blocked if it still has services or sub-categories.

item.description: Manage catalog categories. Categories can nest via `parentId` (e.g. International → Incorporation / Trademark) and order the storefront via `sortOrder`.

item.name: Services

body.raw:
{
  "name": "LLP Registration",
  "slug": "llp-registration",
  "description": "Register your Limited Liability Partnership",
  "categoryId": "{{category_id}}",
  "pricingType": "fixed",
  "billingCycle": "one_time",
  "price": 500000,
  "taxRatePct": 1800,
  "priceInclusiveOfTax": false,
  "isBundle": false,
  "isPurchasable": true,
  "sortOrder": 0
}

request.description: Creates a service. `price` is in paise and may be null for `quote` services. Set `isPurchasable=false` to route customers to an inquiry instead of checkout.

response.name: 201 Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Service created",
  "data": {
    "id": "660e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440001",
    "name": "LLP Registration",
    "slug": "llp-registration",
    "description": "Register your Limited Liability Partnership",
    "price": 799900,
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "2026-04-11T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-04-11T10:00:00.000Z"
  }
}

request.description: Adds a cross-sell add-on (name, price in paise) that customers can select at checkout via `addonIds`.
Adds a line-item to a bundle service (`isBundle` must be true). Optional `componentServiceId` links the line to a standalone service.

item.description: Manage the catalog. Create/update services with the full pricing model (pricingType, billingCycle, price in paise, taxRatePct, priceInclusiveOfTax, isBundle, isPurchasable, categoryId), plus nested add-ons and bundle line-items.

response.name: 200 Paginated List
200 Order Detail

item.name: Inquiries

response.name: 200 Paginated List
200 Inquiry Detail
200 Updated

request.description: Creates a Razorpay Payment Link for an agreed amount (paise) against this inquiry. Auto-links a matching customer and the inquiry's service. Returns the link record incl. `shortUrl`. Marked paid by the `payment_link.paid` webhook.
Lists all payment links generated for this inquiry with their status.

item.description: Handle inquiries and the quote → payment step. For agreed quotes, generate a Razorpay Payment Link that is emailed/SMSed to the customer.

response.name: 200 Reset Link Sent

item.name: Services (Public)

request.description: Returns active services **grouped by category** (ordered by sortOrder). Each service includes `pricingType`, `isPurchasable`, `priceLabel`, `cta`, and `pricing { base, tax, total }`. The frontend keys off `cta` to decide buy vs subscribe vs quote.

response.name: 200 Services Catalog

request.description: Full service detail: category, GST `pricing`, plus **bundle line-items** (when `isBundle`), selectable **add-ons**, and the **subscription plan** (when `recurring`).

response.name: 200 Service

item.description: Public catalog (no auth). Drives the storefront: services grouped by category, each with a `priceLabel`, a `cta` (buy / subscribe / quote), and a GST `pricing` breakdown.

item.name: Purchases

request.description: Creates a pending order + Razorpay order and returns `razorpayOrderId` + `razorpayKeyId` for Checkout. Body: `serviceId`, optional `quantity` (per-unit services) and `addonIds`. Amount = service price + GST + add-ons. Rejected for recurring / quote / non-purchasable services.
Verifies the Razorpay signature after Checkout and marks the payment captured + order confirmed. (The `payment.captured` webhook does the same server-side if the client never calls this.)

response.name: 200 Purchase Detail

item.description: One-time checkout track (`cta = buy`). Flow: Initiate → Razorpay Checkout → Verify. The webhook is the server-side source of truth for confirmation.

item.name: Subscriptions

request.description: Starts a monthly subscription for a `recurring`, purchasable service. Lazily creates the Razorpay Plan, creates the Subscription, and returns `razorpaySubscriptionId` + `shortUrl` for Checkout.
Verifies the subscription handshake signature (`payment_id | subscription_id`) after Checkout and marks the subscription active.
The authenticated customer's subscriptions with service, status, amount, interval, and current period end.
Cancels the subscription at the end of the current billing cycle.

item.description: Recurring track (`cta = subscribe`) for monthly services via Razorpay Subscriptions. Flow: Subscribe → Razorpay Checkout → Verify; `subscription.*` webhooks keep status in sync.

item.name: Inquiry (Public)

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Rahul Sharma",
  "email": "rahul@example.com",
  "phone": "9112233445",
  "subject": "Need help with GST registration",
  "message": "Hi, I want to register for GST for my new business. Can you help?"
}

request.description: Creates an inquiry. Optional `serviceId` links it to a catalog service so the advisor sees the context. Rate-limited.

response.name: 201 Inquiry Submitted
429 Rate Limited

item.description: Entry point for the quote track (`cta = quote`). Customers submit an inquiry, optionally tagged with the `serviceId` they're asking about; an advisor follows up with a payment link.

item.name: Webhooks

request.description: Single endpoint for all Razorpay events. Routes by event prefix: `subscription.*` → subscription status, `payment_link.*` → quote payment status, `payment.*` → order/payment status.

item.description: Razorpay webhook receiver (signature-verified). Handles one-time `payment.*`, `subscription.*`, and `payment_link.*` events — the server-side source of truth for confirming orders, subscriptions, and quote payments.
